title: Staggered version promotion orchestrator for private VPC control plane
creator: Marco Chen
description: Implement an orchestrator that performs staggered control-plane version promotions for Private (VPC) deployments using IaC-driven policies. The goal is to provide a safe, auditable path for moving VPC control planes from one version to the next with automated health gates, predictable scheduling windows, and rollback triggers. This ticket focuses on the orchestration layer and Terraform module hooks (not the runtime binary changes).
acceptance_criteria: A Terraform module API that exposes a version_promotion_policy resource which can be attached to customer VPC control-plane manifests
A promotion plan executor that advances cohorts automatically according to policy and halts on failing health gates
Health gates wired to SLO-based checks and synthetic request probes (success rate, median latency, error budget consumption)
Rollback automation that returns traffic and configuration to the previous version within the configured safety window
Operational dashboards and alerting for each promotion with cohort-level metrics and a single-click abort/rollback in the Console
End-to-end tests (unit + integration + canary simulation) demonstrating 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% promotions and failures triggering a halt and rollback
test_plan: Local dry-run using terraform plan + simulator that exercises the promotion executor without changing control plane state
Staging VPC: run a full promotion with synthetic traffic generator and intentional fault injection at 5% cohort to validate halt and rollback
E2E integration test in CI that runs promotion executor against ephemeral clusters and validates SLO gate logic
Chaos test: randomly fail control-plane API responses during middle cohort to ensure rollbacks are correct and idempotent
steps_to_execute: Design Terraform module interface and version_promotion_policy schema (owner: Aisha)
Implement promotion executor service (stateless controller) that reads Terraform state hooks and triggers orchestrated promotions (owner: Sriram)
Add health gate integrations: Datadog metrics exporter, internal SLO service, synthetic probe runner (owner: Priya)
Add rollback and remediation runbooks and automate a conservative default (5-minute stabilization per cohort)
Create Console UI wireframe for promotion monitoring and single-click abort (owner: Design)
Ship integration tests and add to release gating for private deployment bundles
notes: We will default to a conservative promotion cadence and expose aggressive options behind a feature flag for enterprise customers. The Terraform module must support dry-run and manual-approve modes. Ensure KMS/HSM keys are not touched by the promotion executor — config remains in customer-managed vaults.
